name: OpenClawBrain
description: Learned memory and context from OpenClawBrain

brainRoot.label: Brain Root
brainRoot.help: Directory containing OpenClawBrain state.db and immutable packs

brainEmbeddingProvider.label: Embedding Provider
brainEmbeddingProvider.help: Provider used for learned retrieval embeddings

brainEmbeddingModel.label: Embedding Model
brainEmbeddingModel.help: Embedding model used for init, retrieval, and brain_teach

brainMaxCompileMs.label: Brain Compile Deadline
brainMaxCompileMs.help: Soft wall-clock deadline in milliseconds for brain assembly phase-boundary checks

brainBudgetFraction.label: Brain Budget Fraction
brainBudgetFraction.help: Fraction of the available token budget reserved for retrieval before final prompt clipping

brainMaxFanoutPerNode.label: Brain Max Fanout Per Node
brainMaxFanoutPerNode.help: Maximum accepted traversals from a single source node expansion

brainMaxFrontierSize.label: Brain Max Frontier Size
brainMaxFrontierSize.help: Maximum traversal frontier size during learned retrieval

brainPersistRawSurfaces.label: Persist Raw Brain Surfaces
brainPersistRawSurfaces.help: Store raw prompt, turn, and source audit detail locally in addition to redacted-safe summaries

brainEmbeddingBaseUrl.label: Embedding Base URL
brainEmbeddingBaseUrl.help: Optional base URL override for the embedding provider endpoint

brainMaxHops.label: Brain Max Hops
brainMaxHops.help: Maximum learned-retrieval graph expansion depth per query

brainMaxSeeds.label: Brain Max Seeds
brainMaxSeeds.help: Maximum seed nodes admitted into learned retrieval before graph expansion

brainSemanticThreshold.label: Brain Semantic Threshold
brainSemanticThreshold.help: Minimum semantic similarity required for seed admission during learned retrieval

brainShadowMode.label: Brain Shadow Mode
brainShadowMode.help: Run learned retrieval for telemetry only without injecting brain context into prompts

brainWorkerMode.label: Worker Mode
brainWorkerMode.help: Run the learner in a supervised child process (default) or fall back to in-process mode

brainWorkerHeartbeatTimeoutMs.label: Worker Heartbeat Timeout
brainWorkerHeartbeatTimeoutMs.help: Milliseconds to wait before treating the supervised learner worker as stalled

brainWorkerRestartDelayMs.label: Worker Restart Delay
brainWorkerRestartDelayMs.help: Milliseconds to wait before restarting the supervised learner worker after exit or crash
